public_rationale: The December 2024 TheAgentCompany paper found that the best agent completed only 24% of 175 simulated workplace tasks, and that harder long-horizon tasks were beyond all tested systems. That matches the post's figures. Completing about a quarter of ordinary employee tasks fits a plain reading of 'not close to ready for prime time'. The authors note that a good share of simpler tasks were solved and call the picture nuanced. That softens the tone but does not contradict the claim.
limitations: 'Ready for prime time' is a judgment. The benchmark is a simulated software-company setting, not real deployment.
The claim is about the systems tested at the time. Later models scored higher (30% in the paper's September 2025 revision).

The period runs from the paper's release (December 2024) to the post date.
